newsitem.title: THAILAND: Finance One denies share sale talk.
newsitem.headline: Finance One denies share sale talk.

text.p: Thailand's Finance One Plc on Thursday denied market talk that its major share holders, Thai Farmers Bank Plc and Banque Paribas, had sold off their stake in the company.

"Finance One wants to stress that both major shareholders still have their holdings in the company. So far, there was no sale of the Finance One's share by Thai Farmers Bank and Banque Paribas," Finance One said in a staement.
At the end of March 6, Thai Farmers Bank and Banque Paribas owned 6.92 and 6.87 percent stakes in Finance One respectively, it said.
Finance One and medium-sized Thai Danu Bank Plc announced a friendly merger this week, in one of the biggest consolidations in the Thai finance sector in over a decade.
The two firms said they were awaiting approval from the Thai authorities for the planned merger.
